versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00243 Std_ReturnType SchM_Send_<bsnp>[_<vi>_<ai>]_<name>(IN <data>) with <bsnp> is the BSW Scheduler Name Prefix of the BSW module providing the data according to [SWS_Rte_07593] and [SWS_Rte_07594], <vi> is the vendorId of the BSW module providing the data, <ai> is the vendorApiInfix of the BSW module providing the data, <name> is the shortName of the VariableDataPrototype of this sender-receiver connection. The sub part in square brackets [_<vi>_<ai>] is omitted if no vendorApiInfix is defined for the Basic Software Module . See [SWS_Rte_07528].
